title: Cross-sectional attention to daily relative return
claim: Cross-sectional social attention improves next-day relative return forecasts in the fixed ten-asset panel.
mechanism: Differential attention captures cross-asset information diffusion or crowded demand.

evidence.summary: The holdout candidate was worse than its control; Holm-adjusted p=0.7552 despite a positive gross top-minus-bottom diagnostic.

nextAction: Keep the fixed-panel candidate rejected; a point-in-time universe and fresh confirmation are required for a new cross-sectional version.
